items.title: Every element coprime to b up to a unit makes a monogenic extension of a ring containing a unit of the form a - by
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a monogenic extension A subset B for which u = a - b y becomes a unit, given aA + bA = A with a a root of unity modulo bA (statement lines 14522-14528). The non-formal content is the polynomial recovery: writing 1 - a^n in bA, one solves successively for coefficients a_1, ..., a_n so that 1 = a^n + a_1 a^{n-1} b + ... + a_n b^n (proof lines 14534-14544); the cleanest part is then the prime-ideal argument (proof lines 14546-14564), where for a prime q of B one either uses a unit mod p or substitutes y = a/b mod q and gets b^{-n} = 0, a contradiction. H2: one explicit lifting step and one short prime-ideal check.
